name: indodax-cli
description: Professional-grade Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI for the Indodax cryptocurrency exchange. Provides comprehensive access to real-time market data, secure account management, high-performance spot trading, risk-free paper trading, and live WebSocket event streams. Optimized for LLM agents with detailed tool descriptions, safety guards for dangerous operations, and structured JSON output.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Indodax API Key. Required for private operations like account info, trading, and funding.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your Indodax API Secret. Used to sign private API requests securely.

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_RATE_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Global rate limit for API requests (e.g., 5 requests per second).

environmentVariables.name: INDODAX_WS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Custom authentication token for private WebSocket streams.
